notes.title: Update 1.3.5 - Big Improvements
notes.notes:
This update addressed some major performance issues and several fixes.

- Major performance improvements
- Tons of squashed bugs
- Add secondary button (B) for running using a GamePad
- Minor adjustments with some levels

notes.title: Update 1.3.4 - Small Fixes
notes.notes: This update addresses a couple of issues regarding achievement progression and an issue with the Zone Selection screen crashing.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3 - Achievements!
notes.notes:
This update brings a few bug fixes and finally introduces Steam Achievements.

You can now unlock up to 20 achievements, a couple are going to be part of the next major update which introduces a brand-new zone, so stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Small Patch 1.3.2
notes.notes: This update is a small patch which addresses an issue when saving level goals correctly.
